senses.gloss: m. (אָנַס) compulsion, force; unavoidable interference, accident.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 30a:5">Git. 30ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>אין א׳ בגיטין</he> the plea of unavoidable interference cannot be raised in letters of divorce (to which a condition is attached).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:1:12">Y. M. Kat. III, 81ᵈ</cite> bot., a. e. <he>מחמת אוֹנְסוֹ</he> through no fault of his.—Pl. <he>אוֹנְסִים</he>, <cite ref="A00757"><he>אוֹנְסִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 3:1">Ned. III, 1</cite>, a. e. <he>נדרי א׳</he> vows on conditions unavoidably unfulfilled.
